answer: Wasserstein Traffic-Shape Gate: each agent’s request inter-arrivals over sliding 10-minute windows must match a per-epoch target distribution—lotus burstiness, jade autocorrelation, pigment packet-size mix—within a Wasserstein threshold, with a random phase offset. Sybil clones sharing a scheduler produce near-identical timing spectra and fail; to pass, an attacker must run independent clocks/schedulers and pad idle traffic, paying continuous CPU wakeups and bandwidth for every identity.
